assertions.assertion: Response mentions a migration analysis tool or controller (MigrationAnalysisController) that can be added to the existing IS4 project
assertions.rationale: It names MigrationAnalysisController.cs as a single file dropped into the existing IdentityServer4 project, reachable at /MigrationAnalysis.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions that the tool inspects the running IdentityServer4 instance to provide recommendations
assertions.rationale: It explains the tool runs inside the live IS4 app and reads the actual effective configuration to produce recommendations.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions that the tool checks client counts (interactive vs non-interactive) which helps determine the Duende license edition needed
assertions.rationale: The inspection table lists the client inventory counting interactive vs non-interactive clients to drive the Duende license edition.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions that the tool checks data protection configuration (application discriminator and/or key repository)
assertions.rationale: It lists the data protection application name (discriminator) and repository type as things the tool inspects and flags.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions that the tool checks authentication schemes for compatibility
assertions.rationale: It states the tool lists registered authentication schemes and flags third-party handlers that may need updates.
